assessment.source_outcome: Retain WLC provisionally; extra quantifier remains unresolved
assessment.english_outcome: Retain pinnacles with its existing alternatives; battlements remains a review candidate, not a demonstrated correction
assessment.why: Greek, Syriac and Targum give non-identical architecture; BDB supports both current wording and battlements. Versions do not uniquely identify the original Hebrew sense or missing quantifier.
assessment.counterargument: Battlements more directly communicates the Greek defensive sense; current pinnacles may suggest pointed ornamental features. That is a real tradeoff, not sufficient evidence to replace the Hebrew-based rendering automatically.
